audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads HARD while tone is the favoured green, diffRating is 4/10, and both summary strings say 'Favoured matchup'. The chart also disagrees with the mirror on four rows.
audit.why: The enum was the only field saying HARD; every other signal on the page, plus a 71.43% win rate, says favoured. Separately the mirror moved Level 2 to Illaoi, Level 6 to Illaoi, First item to Skill and 2+ items to Lillia — this page still has the pre-mirror version on all four.
audit.corrected: diff set to FAV to match the tone, rating and summaries; chart rows 2, 6, First item and 2+ items flipped in both layers to match the mirror, ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet reports zero sequencing cues — not one cooldown appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 from 900 range, so a miss buys 16 whole seconds at rank 1 — that is the green light the page keeps gesturing at without numbering. Harsh Lesson is 4 seconds, which is why she re-leaps onto you repeatedly. Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1. Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 16s, 4s, 120s and 150s written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], the do's, the phases, whys[4], early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings call Illaoi 'dash-less', 'immobile' and 'a champion with zero dashes'.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson (W) is a 400-range LEAP to her target on a 4-second cooldown, and Riot's text confirms it — 'Illaoi leaps to her target'. It also makes nearby Tentacles swing at that target and it is an auto-attack reset. A Lillia player told Illaoi cannot close distance will stand at 450 expecting to be safe and get leapt on every four seconds.
audit.corrected: Harsh Lesson named as a 4-second 400-range leap in whys[0], whys[6], early, late and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings tell the reader to 'sprint away from your own tentacles' after Test of Spirit lands.
audit.why: That is backwards and it is the most punishing error on the page. Riot's text: 'If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles.' Running from your spirit is exactly what converts you into a Vessel. The mirror made the same correction from Illaoi's side.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and early now say the spirit must be killed or fought, never fled.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] says Leap of Faith spawns 'a wall of tentacles you cannot kite all of'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit.' In a lane 1v1 that is exactly one tentacle. The wall only exists in a teamfight, so the lane advice overstates it badly.
audit.corrected: Restated as one tentacle per champion hit, with the 120s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states the Dream Dust precondition on Lilting Lullaby.
audit.why: Riot's text Drowsies only 'enemies with Dream Dust on them'. Against Illaoi that means a Q or E must land before the 150-second ultimate does anything at all — and it is the reason the level 6 stage belongs to her, not you.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[4], phases[4].why, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Illaoi as 'he' and 'his'.
audit.why: Illaoi is female; the TL;DR opens with 'He's a treadmill victim'.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in tldr, report[0] and the wave block.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are Illaoi's window, so respect it: with E up and a few tentacles planted she can rip your spirit and force a fight on her terms, and her AOE slams out-damage your poke if you get greedy. Don't dive into the field to land W — kite the edge, throw Q sweetspots and Swirlseed, and let the Dream Dust DoT do the work while you stay mobile. At 6, Lilting Lullaby (R) lets you sleep her to cancel a Test of Spirit chase or set up a jungle gank, but the sleep delay means you want a stacked-passive setup before you commit.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are Illaoi's window, so respect it: with Test of Spirit up — 16s at rank 1 — and tentacles planted she rips your spirit and fights on her terms, and her slams out-damage your poke if you get greedy. Don't step into the field to land W; kite the edge, throw Q sweetspots and Swirlseed, and let Dream Dust do the work. At 6 Lilting Lullaby costs 150 seconds and only sleeps a target already carrying Dream Dust, so land a Q or E first — and remember Harsh Lesson re-leaps onto you every 4 seconds.

edits.before: By first item — Liandry's or Riftmaker — your W and Dream Dust become percent-HP burn that grinds straight through her tentacle sustain, and that's where the 71% win rate lives. You permanently kite a champion with zero dashes: stack Q move speed, keep her chasing into your DoT, and never let her plant a tentacle field around you. Use your roams while she's stuck shoving a wave, and only ever fight her in open ground away from her tentacles — pulled off her field, Illaoi is just a slow target eating your burn.
edits.after: By first item — Liandry's or Riftmaker — your W and Dream Dust become percent-HP burn that grinds through her tentacle healing, and that's where the 71% win rate lives. You out-pace a champion whose only mobility is a 400-range leap onto a target: stack Q move speed, keep her chasing into your DoT, and never let her plant a field around you. Use your roams while she shoves, and fight her only in open ground away from tentacles — off her field, Illaoi is a slow target eating your burn.

notes: Two corrections here matter more than the rest. (1) The page called Illaoi dash-less in three places — Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap onto her target every 4 seconds, so 'she can never catch you' was actively dangerous advice. (2) Two strings told the reader to sprint away from their own spirit after Test of Spirit lands; Riot's text says getting too far from the spirit is precisely what turns you into a Vessel. The suspectNames hit on 'Her Leap of Faith' is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is her real ultimate name. Chart flips match the mirror's four rows exactly and are proposed as one atomic group with their ratings. diff was HARD while tone, diffRating and both summary strings all said favoured; I set the enum to FAV rather than rewrite four strings, and left diffRating at 4/10 (the mirror moved its own side to 5/10, which is compatible).
